dawn.blog.post.field.title: Title
dawn.blog.post.field.excerpt_comment: Short summary shown on the blog overview and in search results.
dawn.blog.category.field.name: Name
dawn.blog.tag.field.name: Name
dawn.settings.field.brand_name_comment: Shown in the header, footer and page titles. Empty: uses the theme customize value, then "Dawn".
dawn.settings.field.brand_logo_comment: Replaces the brand dot and name in header and footer when set. The brand name remains the accessible label.
dawn.settings.field.show_header_cta_comm: The call-to-action button in the top navigation.
dawn.settings.field.show_language_choose: The language picker in the header and the language links in the footer.
dawn.settings.field.header_cta_label_com: Empty: uses the translated default ("Get in touch").
dawn.settings.field.header_cta_url_comme: Empty: links to the contact page.
dawn.settings.field.footer_links_comment: Extra links shown in the footer's "More" column below the Blog link.
dawn.page.field.title: Title
dawn.page.field.hide_from_nav_comment: When on, this page still has its own URL but is not listed in the site's main navigation.
dawn.page.field.show_in_footer_comment: Lists the page in the footer's legal row (next to the copyright) once it is published — ideal for imprint and privacy pages.
dawn.page.field.og_image_comment: Shown when the page is shared on social networks. Empty: uses the theme's default image.
dawn.page.field.canonical_url_comment: Overrides the canonical link when this page duplicates content that lives at another address. Empty: uses this page's own URL.
dawn.page.field.seo_noindex_comment: When on, search engines are asked not to index this page (noindex, nofollow).
dawn.page.field.schema_type_comment: The schema.org type emitted as JSON-LD for rich results. Extra fields appear below for the chosen type.
dawn.page.field.org_same_as_comment: One URL per line (sameAs) — e.g. LinkedIn, X, Facebook.
dawn.page.field.lb_hours_comment: One rule per line, e.g. Mo-Fr 09:00-18:00 or Sa 10:00-14:00. Days: Mo, Tu, We, Th, Fr, Sa, Su.
dawn.theme.form.brand_name.label: Brand name
dawn.theme.form.brand_name.comment: Shown in the header, footer, page titles and structured data. Child themes and reskins change it here — no template edits needed.
dawn.theme.form.view_transitions.label: Page view transitions
dawn.theme.form.view_transitions.comment: Enable smooth cross-fade animations between page navigations (October Turbo View Transitions, requires v4.3+). Turn off to fall back to instant page swaps.
dawn.theme.form.show_slider_pause.label: Show slider pause buttons
dawn.theme.form.show_slider_pause.commen: Show the pause/play button on autoplaying sliders. Turn off to hide the buttons; autoplay is then switched off on all sliders, so nothing moves without the visitor.
dawn.settings.field.blog_layout_comment: How the blog overview presents posts.
dawn.settings.field.blog_per_page_commen: Number of posts before pagination kicks in.
dawn.block.image-bubbles.name: Image with bubbles
dawn.block.image-bubbles.image_comment: SVGs render as-is (their own animations keep running); photos are resized.
dawn.block.image-bubbles.bubbles_comment: Up to six floating pills around the image, one per anchor spot.
dawn.block.hero.name: Hero header
dawn.block.hero.eyebrow_comment: Small badge line above the title (optional).
dawn.block.hero.title: Title
dawn.block.hero.title_accent_comment: Rendered after the title in the Dawn gradient (optional).
dawn.block.hero.video_comment: An mp4/webm from the media library; plays muted in a loop.
dawn.block.hero-numbers.name: Hero numbers
dawn.block.hero-numbers.label: Label
dawn.block.features.name: Features
dawn.block.features.title: Title
dawn.block.pricing-table.name: Pricing table
dawn.block.pricing-table.period_comment: Shown under the amount, e.g. "per month". Optional.
dawn.block.pricing-table.tagline_comment: Short line instead of / after the period, e.g. "For side projects".
dawn.block.pricing-table.features_commen: One feature per line — each gets a checkmark.
dawn.block.blog-slider.name: Blog posts slider
dawn.block.blog-slider.preview_empty: Blog slider: no published posts yet.
dawn.block.data-table.name: Data table
dawn.block.data-table.caption: Caption
dawn.block.data-table.caption_comment: Optional table caption (shown below the table).
dawn.block.data-table.header_comment: Pipe-separated column headers, e.g. "Plan | Sites | Support".
dawn.menu.field.mode_comment: Normal builds the navigation automatically from the page tree. Mega menu lets you compose the structure below — entries with sub-links open as a full-width panel.
dawn.menu.field.items_comment: Top-level navigation entries. An entry with sub-links gets a chevron and opens a mega panel; without sub-links it is a plain link.
dawn.menu.field.item_children_comment: The links shown inside this entry's mega panel.
dawn.menu.field.item_description_comment: Short one-liner shown under the link in the panel (optional).
dawn.menu.field.item_label_comment: Falls back to the linked page's title when empty.
dawn.menu.field.item_link_comment: Pick a page, blog post or CMS page — or enter a free URL.
dawn.menu.group.category_desc: A label-only entry that opens a panel of sub-links plus an optional content card.
dawn.menu.field.category_label_comment: Categories are not links — the label opens the panel.
dawn.menu.field.content_side_comment: Where the content card sits on desktop — the sub-links take the other side. On mobile both stack below each other.
dawn.menu.field.content_text_comment: Short formatted teaser shown on the content card (optional).
dawn.menu.field.item_icon_comment: Optional Lucide icon shown in front of the label.
dawn.block.jobs-listing.name: Job listings
dawn.block.jobs-listing.empty_text_comme: Shown when there are no active positions. Leave empty to hide the block entirely.
dawn.block.jobs-listing.preview_empty: Jobs listing: no active positions yet.
dawn.jobs.position.field.title: Title
dawn.jobs.position.field.department_comm: e.g. Engineering, Design, Support. Shown as the card kicker.
dawn.jobs.position.field.excerpt_comment: One or two sentences shown on the listing card and used as the JobPosting description.
dawn.jobs.position.field.cover_comment: Optional. Shown on the listing when the block has preview images enabled.
dawn.jobs.position.field.valid_through_c: Last day the posting is active. After this date it drops off the listing and the JobPosting validThrough.
dawn.jobs.position.field.applicant_locat: For remote/hybrid roles: where applicants may be based, e.g. "EU" or "Germany".
dawn.jobs.position.field.job_country_com: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. DE.
dawn.jobs.position.field.salary_currency: ISO 4217 code, e.g. EUR. Salary only appears in schema.org when a currency is set.
dawn.jobs.position.field.hiring_org_name: Defaults to the brand name when empty.
dawn.jobs.position.field.apply_url_comme: Where the Apply button links. Leave empty to hide the button.
dawn.appointment.name: Appointment request
dawn.appointment.field.name: Name
dawn.appointment.field.message_comment: Anything we should know before the appointment.
dawn.appointment.field.attachment_commen: PDF or image, up to 2 files. Stored privately — only the team sees it.
dawn.appointment.field.privacy: I have read and accept the privacy policy
dawn.appointment.field.internal_note_com: Only visible in the backend — never part of the frontend form.
